description: This PHP source file defines a utility class 'SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1' extending 'SugarWebServiceUtilv3' with methods for web service support in SuiteCRM, including field retrieval, module handling, view definitions, file encoding, and ACL management.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1
classes.description: A utility class extending SugarWebServiceUtilv3, providing methods for module field retrieval, view management, module filtering, file handling, and ACL checks.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves module fields and link fields for a given value object and module.

methods.name: trackView
methods.description: Tracks a user view action for analytics purposes.

methods.name: getModulesFromList
methods.description: Converts a list of modules into web service result with labels and ACL info.

methods.name: get_visible_modules
methods.description: Fetches modules that are enabled and visible based on user session and system tabs.

methods.name: generateUnifiedSearchFields
methods.description: Generates search fields for a module for unified search functionality.

methods.name: checkModuleRoleAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for various actions on a module.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Extracts field definitions and link fields from a value object.

methods.name: get_file_contents_base64
methods.description: Returns file contents encoded in base64, optionally deletes file after reading.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Retrieves view definitions for a specified module and view type.

methods.name: get_data_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of records from a seed object, with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: addFieldLevelACLs
methods.description: Adds ACL-based restrictions to view metadata.

methods.name: getFieldLevelACLValue
methods.description: Returns raw ACL permission level for a specific field.
